name: Onna no ko no yami o nozoite mimasen ka?
original_name: 女の子の闇を覗いてみませんか?
source:
“Hey, Wakaba, have you ever seen a guy masturbating before?”
“Huh?”
A maiden’s curiosity knows no bounds, and they push forward to the very edge.
What will become of Wakaba and Mayu?
The moment they witness something they were never meant to see, the two girls begin chasing after their desires!
